_comment: Reviewed, committed pins for the ONE-TIME Base Mainnet MPGRExecutorDelegated deployment (the delegated autonomous executor). This is a SEPARATE artifact from deploy-config.json (the v1 assisted executor 0xD982...505A) and a SEPARATE contract: v1 pulls tokens only from msg.sender and is structurally incapable of executing for a user, so it must NEVER be used for delegated autonomous execution. NOT YET DEPLOYED: mainnetDelegatedDeployEnabled is false, so script/DeployMPGRExecutorDelegatedBaseMainnet.s.sol refuses to run. To deploy, an operator must set it true in a reviewed commit AND set MPGR_MAINNET_DELEGATED_DEPLOY_ENABLED=true in the environment (two independent flags), use a fresh dedicated deployer key (nonce 0), and afterwards pin the resulting address in MPGR_MAINNET_DELEGATED_EXECUTOR. See docs/EXECUTOR-ARCHITECTURE-DECISION.md. Routers: BOTH production venues are allowlisted (see that doc section 7) - Aerodrome Slipstream for every USDC<->B20 tokenized-stock pair, and Uniswap V3 SwapRouter02 for USDC<->WETH, because lib/executor/executor-config.ts declares both as production routes and the deploy script asserts the two never drift. Fee model is identical to v1: 25 bps, hard on-chain cap 100 bps, fee taken in the SELL token. The executor includes the typed module registry, but it is intentionally empty at initial deployment; no venue module is pre-approved.

routers._note: Deliberately allowlisted HERE but NOT on the deployed v1 executor (its routerAllowlist is Slipstream-only). See docs/EXECUTOR-ARCHITECTURE-DECISION.md section 7: the TS mainnet route table declares this venue, so the delegated executor must accept it or autonomous USDC->WETH goals would revert RouterNotAllowed after the user signed.

denied._comment: Addresses that must NEVER appear as the deployer, owner, fee recipient, broadcaster, router or token in a mainnet delegated deployment. The canary wallet is the Phase 5 one-shot test wallet; the Sepolia entries are testnet contracts that must never be allowlisted on mainnet.

_typedModulesNote: The immutable core includes an owner-governed typed module registry. No modules are configured at initial deployment; a future module must be separately deployed per executor/router, code-reviewed, registered by governance and pinned by runtime bytecode hash. This is not a proxy/upgrade path.
